[EN] Poison for Poison
[ES] Veneno contra veneno
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] We need that fungus to cure the venom.
[ES] Necesitamos ese hongo para curar el veneno.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I'll start working on an antidote at once.
[ES] Empezaré a trabajar en un antídoto de inmediato.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Gather adderfungus from the corridors around the Ecdysi Atrium.
[ES] Recolecta hongo víbora en los pasillos alrededor de Ecdysi Atrium.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return to Odrun at the Ecdysi Atrium.
[ES] Regresa con Odrun en Ecdysi Atrium.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
